responsibilities.en: Responsible for executing tasks with a short-term focus (daily to weekly) within their own area, following budget guidelines, and contributing to functional goals without direct managerial duties.

Responsible for coordinating the execution of operational goals with a medium-term focus (weekly to monthly) within a small area or department, managing operating costs, and overseeing one functional unit.

Responsible for aligning unit plans with organizational strategy with a long-term focus (1 year) within a small country, balancing revenue growth with cost management, and managing one or two closely related functions.

Responsible for executing organizational strategy with a long-term focus (1-2 years) across an entire country or region, handling full P&L responsibilities, and overseeing multiple business functions.

Responsible for setting organizational direction and long-term strategy with a multi-year focus (3-5 years) across the entire organization or a multi-country region, owning capital allocation and consolidated P&L across business units, and leading other senior leaders across all business functions.
